property_summary: After any admissible DrugDealer call, either the call reverts (caller not CEO) or ceoAddress is set to the caller and is never the zero address; the mutant sets ceoAddress to address(0) on a successful call, breaking this for the CEO caller.

For any caller with kilos, calling collectDrugs after sufficient elapsed time must strictly increase that caller's Kilos balance (newly produced kilos are credited); the mutant never increases Kilos in collectDrugs, so for any input with Kilos>0 and elapsed time >= 288s the buggy version leaves Kilos unchanged.

For any initialized setup, any caller and any ref, one call to collectDrugs adds exactly floor(elapsedCappedDrugs/86400) kilos to Kilos[caller] (one kilo per full 86400 drug cycle, capped at one day's worth), whereas the mutant adds twice that (two kilos).

After a caller with zero kilos uses getFreeKilo and waits exactly one day before a single collectDrugs call, Kilos[caller] must equal exactly 2*STARTING_KILOS (one day's production = STARTING_KILOS kilos added once); the mutant doubles the daily increment, yielding 3*STARTING_KILOS.

In the reference contract, a second collectDrugs call at the same timestamp adds no new Kilos (pending drugs were consumed by resetting lastCollect); the mutant leaves lastCollect stale, so the same accrued drugs are converted to Kilos twice, changing Kilos on the second call.
